subject: Multiregion qualification deep-dive: model fit & next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@sentrahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Multiregion qualification deep-dive: model fit & next steps

Emma — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps for the model-fit follow-up across EU (FR/DE/NL) and APAC (JA/KO):

Call summary (2/3):
- Primary goal: automated intake summarization + entity extraction for clinical intake forms, across EN/FR/DE/JA/KO.
- Acceptance criteria: per-language extract F1 >= 0.88 on the benchmark prompt set; latency target 95th <= 450ms for short (<=128 token) generations; data residency for EU PII.
- Key constraints: SentraHealth needs private VPC for production and SOC2 evidence; pilot can run hosted sandbox.

Suggested models to evaluate (initial shortlist):
- rw/multi-compact-7B-v2 (fast, strong FR/DE) — candidate for EU baseline
- open-multilingual-13B-q4_0 (higher-quality for JA/KO but heavier)
- rw/med-lite-3B-quant (cost-friendly for lower criticality paths such as triage summaries)

Benchmarks and deliverables I'm proposing for the pilot (attached):
- bench matrix: per-language BLEU/ROUGE + entity F1, latency percentile table (benchmarks_eu_apac_2028.xlsx).
- prompt pack: initial instruction templates + 120 labeled examples (prompt_set_sentrahealth_v1.zip).
- risk watchlist: known DE/FR morphology failure modes, JA honorific tokenization drift, KO spacing/segmentation regressions.

Immediate asks / next steps (owner + ETA):
1) Emma: share two sample intake forms (anonymized) and a short list of entities you need extracted (due 2028-10-09).
2) Neha: spin up a 3-model eval run (rw/multi-compact-7B-v2, open-multilingual-13B-q4_0, rw/med-lite-3B-quant) on SentraHealth prompt set — gather F1 + latency (due 2028-10-12).
3) Ben: prepare a short cost estimate for both hosted pilot and Dedicated reserved capacity for a 3-month pilot (due 2028-10-11).

Risk and regression monitoring notes:
- We'll include a small holdout set for regression detection; propose automated weekly quality diffs posted to the Console and a Slack alert for >3% F1 drop.
- For EU PII handling, add a policy to route EU requests to Dedicated or the private VPC; confirm with Security.

Attachments: prompt_set_sentrahealth_v1.zip (prompt templates + 120 labeled examples), benchmarks_eu_apac_2028.xlsx (initial measurement matrix), pilot_scope_statement.pdf

Let me know if anything above is off. If you're happy, I will kick off the eval jobs once we have the sample data.

— Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@sentrahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T13:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Multiregion qualification deep-dive: model fit & next steps

Aditya — super helpful recap, thank you. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Entities: patient_name, symptoms_free_text, referral_reason_code, date_of_visit, clinician_notes (we can provide labels for a 300-example pilot).
2) Data: we'll provide two anonymized PDFs and an exported CSV of 500 rows (PHI removed) by Monday (2028-10-09). EU records originate in FR/DE offices; APAC is Japan/Korea.
3) Latency: 450ms 95th is great — if that requires a smaller model for DE/FR we are willing to trade off a small quality drop for predictability.

Couple of asks:
- Can you add an explicit check for tokenization drift in JA and KO in the benchmark sheet? We saw drift in a prior vendor pilot.
- For the SOC2 evidence: can you share a short checklist of what Redwood will provide for the pilot? (runbooks, IAM configs, audit logs)

We'll aim to get the samples over Monday. After that, happy to get the eval results and a quick walkthrough.

— Emma
Head of Product, SentraHealth
emma.jensen@sentrahealth.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@sentrahealth.com>
Date: 2028-10-06T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multiregion qualification deep-dive: model fit & next steps

Looping in status after I reviewed the prompt pack and initial bench matrix. Quick notes from the ops/evals side: 

- I added a tokenization-drift column for JA/KO (basic detokenizer differences + character-coverage check) and a small synthetic stress set for honorifics/politeness that will highlight failure modes in JA.
- I will run the three initial models on the 500-row CSV you promised — will include per-row confidence and entity-level deltas so SentraHealth can triage.
- Early expectation: rw/multi-compact-7B-v2 should meet entity F1 in FR/DE for extraction but may underperform on summary fluency for JA/KO vs open-multilingual-13B-q4_0. That's why I'm including both.

Proposed eval plan (short):
A) Quick smoke (2 days): run end-to-end extraction + latency profiling on hosted sandbox.
B) Deeper run (up to 7 days): full 500-row pass + holdout for weekly regression checks.

I'll start smoke runs once Emma drops the CSV. Ben — please confirm if you want me to provision Dedicated instances for the deeper run or we should try hosted burst capacity first.

— Neha
Sr. Applied ML | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@sentrahealth.com>
Date: 2028-10-07T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multiregion qualification deep-dive: model fit & next steps

Thanks team — quick commercial note and the plan I will move forward with: 

- Hosted pilot cost estimate (3 weeks): ~$8,500 — includes 2x burst GPU runs for the 13B eval and 30k token compute for benchmarking.
- Dedicated pilot (3 months, reserved): pricing ballpark ~ $42k/month (we'll refine based on throughput SLOs).
- I'll attach a short one-pager with the two options and a simple runbook for switching to Dedicated if the deeper run shows regressions requiring pinned capacity.

Operational note: to minimize risk of regression in production, we recommend:
1) Start with rw/multi-compact-7B-v2 as the EU extraction baseline (lower latency) and hold open-multilingual-13B-q4_0 for APAC summary workflows.
2) Add weekly automated quality diffs and a regression Slack channel hook; if F1 drops >3% on the holdout we auto-rollback to the last good pinned model.

Emma — if this aligns with your expectations, I'll: (a) put the hosted pilot quote into HubSpot, (b) send the Dedicated ballpark to procurement, and (c) drop the one-pager to this thread.

— Ben
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
